content: 'Ixumeritsie kemɨra'urixɨ
Hikɨ ti'aitame Weritsatsaxi 'ikwai 'ixɨarariyari kaniuwewieni mariweme, kaniwaruta'inieni xeimiriyari teɨteri waɨkawa memeuyewetse mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie, mɨkɨ wahamatɨa winu kaniuti'ieni kaniutitaweni.

Mexi me'iekai, Weritsatsaxi katiniuta'aita huru meta pɨrata tekɨxiyari mɨ'atɨiyarienikɨ paapaya Nawukurunutsuxi, Kerutsareme tukita meiyehapakai. Mɨpaɨ katiniɨyɨni. Tekɨxite kani'atɨiyarieni, hikɨ mɨkɨ ti'aitame meta 'iparewiwametemama mɨkɨta mekateniuka'ieni, yɨ'ɨitama wahamatɨa meta yutuxexerima wahamatɨa.
'Ari metarɨwetɨ, yukakaɨyarixima mekaniwanɨawakaitɨni, huru, pɨrata, wurunitse, tepɨa, kɨye meta tetexi kakaɨyarixiyari.
'Ana kwitɨ, paratsiyuta memɨwayutixexeɨriwatsie mamá kaniuhekɨare, kɨxeme hekɨariwiekaku, 'ixumeri mutuxatsie yu'itɨwamekɨ katina'utɨwakaitɨni. Ti'aitame mexi mamá mɨra'utɨwa xeiyakai,
marikakɨ yuhɨxie kanayeture, tunuteya kaniutiyɨyɨakakaitɨni, waɨriyarika 'akaniuwekaitɨni.

Hikɨ katiniuta'aita mara'akate, muyuawitsie timiemekɨ memɨteyɨ'ukitɨa meta memɨtehetimamateke hɨxiena memɨ'axɨanikɨ, mɨkɨ temaiwawemete Wawiruniya kiekatari mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Kemɨ'ane huta ma'uxa makaterɨwa meta mɨnetsitahekɨatɨani kehepaɨtɨtɨ manɨyɨne, ne 'ixuriki mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ nekanitikemaritɨamɨkɨ, huru kukayari nekanekatɨtɨamɨkɨ meta hairieka mieme kuwexinarurikɨ nekanenayexeiyamɨkɨ.
Temaiwawemete yunaitɨ mɨra'aita kiekatari mekaniu'axɨani, matsi mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memekaterɨwa meta ti'aitame yamemɨtetahɨawe ketɨtɨ manɨyɨne.
'Ana matsi ti'aitame Weritsatsaxi waɨkawa matsi kaniutimani meta waɨkawa kanayeture yuhɨxie. Meta 'iparewiwametemama 'atsimepɨkatemaikai kememɨyɨnikeyu.

Ti'aitame meta 'iparewiwametemama kwinimieme me'utainekaku, 'uka ti'aitame 'u'enaka memɨwayetei heutahaka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―'Ekɨ ti'aitame peke'ayeyurini yuheyemekɨ. Pepɨkayu'iyaritɨaka meta yɨkɨ pepɨkaraka'erieka 'ahɨxie pepɨka'ayetuxani.

'Ekɨ ti'aitame pemɨra'aitatsie xewitɨ 'apuyeika kakaɨyarixi memɨpatsie wa'iyari hexeiyatɨ. Kepauka ti'aitame 'amuyeikakai Nawukurunutsuxi, 'ekɨ 'apaapa, mɨkɨ tewi pukaxeiyarie timaiwetɨ, yapauka retimamateketɨ, kakaɨyarixi 'iyari memexeiya hepaɨ 'aneme hexeiyame. 'Ekɨ ti'aitame 'apaapa penukake temaiwawemete, mara'akate, muyuawitsie timiemekɨ memɨteyu'ukitɨa meta memɨtehetimamateke wa'ukiyari mɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.

Mɨkɨ tewi kwinimieme katinimaiweni, waɨkawa katinakumaika, meta katinimateni metatsiere kaniyɨweni heinɨtsika mɨtahekɨata, mɨranukaname mutaxata kaniyɨweni meta mɨtikwaniwetɨka 'aixɨa katinakayuruwani. Mɨkɨ tewi ketineutanɨ'airi, mɨkɨ yakametinitaxatɨamɨkɨ kehepaɨtɨtɨ mɨre'uxa. Tanieri katinitewaka, tsepanetɨ 'ekɨ ti'aitame 'apaapa Werititsatsaxi mɨtiterɨwakai.
Tanieri ti'aitame hɨxie kani'atɨarieni, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: ―¿Kamɨtsɨ 'ekɨ Tanieri petihɨkɨ waniu, Kura kwieyaritsie nepaapa mɨxeheyehapa?
Mɨpaɨ nepɨtikuxaxatɨariwa kename 'ekɨ kakaɨyarixi wa'iyari pehexeiya, kename kwinimieme petimate meta waɨkawa perakumate.
Temaiwawemete meta mara'akate nehɨxie mepu'axɨa 'utɨarika me'akaterɨwake meta memɨnetsitahekɨatɨanikɨ kehepaɨtɨtɨ manuyɨne, matsi mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa.

Mɨpaɨ nepɨtikɨhɨawarɨwa kename 'ekɨ petihekɨatawe meta kename mɨtikwaniwetɨka 'aixɨa perakayuruwa. Xɨka pehekaterɨwa meta pe'itahekɨata huta kemɨre'uxa, 'ixuriki mɨyɨtsikimaɨye nepɨmetsi'anakatɨtɨani, huru kukayari nekamenakatɨtɨamɨkɨ, meta hairieka mieme kuwexinarurikɨ nekamenanukakemɨkɨ.

Tanieri mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ―'Ekɨ ti'aitame mɨkɨ 'imikieri ketineuti'uta, yanutsutɨni xeime keneyetuiri. 'Ekɨ ti'aitame, ne nepɨmatsi'akaterɨwirieni 'ixumeritsie kemɨxe'uxa meta nekamenitahekɨatɨamɨkɨ kehepaɨtɨtɨ manɨyɨne.
»Kakaɨyari 'Amutewi 'apaapa Nawukurunutsuxi kaniupitɨani, mɨmariwenikɨ, xawatɨriya mexeiyanikɨ, mɨti'aitanikɨ 'aixɨa rahɨawarɨwatɨ.

Kakaɨyari 'ipitɨaku mɨti'aitanikɨ, hɨxiena yunaitɨ teɨteri mekaniutiyɨyɨakakaitɨni, nuiwarite meta yunaitɨ yɨkɨ memɨte'uniuka. Kemɨ'ane meumiemɨkɨkai puwatakukuyakai, kemɨ'ane mɨreuyehɨwiriemɨkɨkai pɨtiwareuyehɨwiriwakai, kemɨ'ane mariweme mauyeitɨamɨkɨkai mariweme puwarayeitɨwakai, meta xɨka xeime tixaɨtɨ katihɨkɨtɨme heuyeitɨamɨkɨni, mɨkɨ tixaɨtɨ katihɨkɨtɨme payeitɨwakai.
Peru kepauka 'iyarieya matsi 'axatiuka'iyaritɨ matɨa meta muyuta'ɨrixɨ, ti'aitame 'uwenieya kaniunawaiyarieni, xawatɨriya kemɨrexeiyakai katiniunawaiyarieni,

teɨteri watsata kananayehanieni meta yeutanaka 'iyarieya kaniupitɨarieni, puxuri yeutari watsata kaniuyeikakaitɨni meta tewaxi wahepaɨ 'ɨxa kaniutikwani, tɨkarikɨ haɨtsiya hetsiena kaniupaparekaitɨni. Mɨkɨ naitɨ hetsiena mɨpaɨ katiniuyɨni, 'anake mɨpaɨ katinetimani kename Kakaɨyari 'Amutewi kwiepa yunaime te'aitamete kwiepa memɨtama tiwa'aitɨwame hɨkɨ meta kename mɨkɨ xeikɨa te'aitamete waranuka'uitɨwa.
»Peru mɨyatɨtɨ, 'ikɨ naime petimaitɨtɨtɨ, 'ekɨ, Nawukurunutsuxi nu'aya, tixaɨtɨ pekatihɨkɨtɨtɨ pepɨka'ayuyeitɨawe.

Matsi pɨta, Kakaɨyari muyuawitsie makawe pepaye'unie, pepɨtiuta'ai tekɨxite mɨhapaniemiekɨ tukitana mieme, hetana xemɨti'ienikɨ 'ekɨ meta 'aparewiwamete, meta xe'ɨitama metatsiere xetuxexerima. 'Ekɨ pepɨ'ayetua pewanɨawatɨ kakaɨyarixi memɨwewiyatɨka, hurukɨ, pɨratakɨ, tepɨakɨ, kɨyekɨ meta tetekɨ, mɨkɨ kakaɨyarixi memɨkaheuneniere, memɨkaheu'enana meta memɨkaheti'enatɨkɨka, matsi Kakaɨyari mariweme pepɨka'ayeitɨa tukari mɨmatsipitɨa meta kepemɨti'aitani mɨmatsipitɨa.
'Ayumieme Kakaɨyari mɨkɨ mamá peyenɨ'a mɨkɨ mɨra'utɨanikɨ,
huta ma'uxa: Meneni, Meneni, Tekeri, Paritsini.
»Mɨpaɨ kananɨyɨneni, huta ma'uxa:
»Meneni: Kakaɨyari tukari puti'inɨataxɨ kepaɨmexɨa pemɨti'aitani 'ekɨ, 'ari penu'atɨa.
»Tekeri: 'Ekɨ ti'aitame ti'inɨnɨatametsie pekananɨyewiyani, kepemɨrahetenikeyu mɨpaɨ pepɨkareuhana.
»Paritsini: 'Ekɨ ti'aitame pemɨra'aita panutahutarixɨ, meta mepɨyetuiriyarie merutsixi meta peritsatsixi».
Hikɨ Weritsatsaxi katiniuta'aita Tanieri 'ixuriki mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ mɨtikemaritɨarienikɨ, huru kukayari makatɨtɨarienikɨ meta hairieka mieme kuwexinarurikɨ manayexeiyarienikɨ.
Mɨkɨ tɨkariyaritsie Weritsatsaxi kaniumierieni, wawiruniyutsixi tiwa'aitɨwame, hikɨ Rariyu Peritsa kiekame pɨta mana katiniuta'aita.
'Ana, Rariyu haika tewiyari heimana huta wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni.
